notes: Fighter class: 0x7104f85690 (784 bytes), NOT the larger 0x7105179668. Evidence: the fighter's module-accessor builder f_71006882d0 (already identified for KineticModule) allocates 0x310 bytes and stores 0x7104F85690, and research/map/reference_types.json names that vptr app::AreaModule; the 1136-byte class holds a single inline area entry with default group AREA_GROUP_WEAPON. Vtables read from the dump with rtti.Names().word: both classes share the base functions for every exported slot except force_update (fighter f_71006b18f0: base update then f_71006b4e80 when awake) and clean (single-area class also clears its private log). Layout: base 0x00-0x5F common to both classes; per-area data lives behind +0x18 (0x70-byte entries) and their instances (entry+0x28); getters do not bounds-check except is_enable_area, is_exist_area_instance, set_layer. Wind: erase_wind/add_wind_area_2nd(_rad) (f_71003cfc80, f_71003d03e0, f_71003d0680) were not decoded in detail. Single-area class (0x7105179668) extra fields: 0x60 area param copy (0x60 shape type, 0x61 group, 0x62 flags, 0x70 node hash40 'top', 0x78 offset vec2, 0x80 size vec2), 0x90 inline entry table (count 0xA0, array ptr 0xA8 -> one entry at 0xB0), 0x120 inline contact log (cap 8, count 0x130, records at 0x140), 0x240 second small container, 0x2D0/0x2E0/0x2F0 triangle vertices (shape type 6), 0x320 private contact log (count 0x330, records 0x340), 0x450 owner position vec4, 0x460 f32 rounded into the instance layer.
